versions.changelog: v1.1.0 — Migrate routing to the Agents API (/api/v1/agents/:id/chat, AI_SAAS_AGENT_ID) with legacy chatbot fallback. Add AI Growth Engine (AutoPilot) commands — deploy/pause/status via /api/v1/drip-agent/chat with confirm-before-act. Fix required env (CHATBOT_ID → AGENT_ID).

amernet-ai-saas v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Connects your AI SaaS intelligent agent to any messaging channel supported by OpenClaw (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage, and more)
- Forwards messages from users to a selected AI SaaS chatbot and returns responses, maintaining separate sessions per user and channel
- Supports conversation reset via keywords or commands, and replies with confirmation
- Provides chatbot status information in response to "/status" or "/ping"
- Returns a friendly error if the AI service is unavailable
